plan.problem: SceneLoader converts cached RGB bytes to a new float vector and GPU tensor on every consumed training image. Dense capture revisits the same images thousands of times.
plan.change: Optional immutable image-tensor reuse, limited to 256 MiB logical tensor bytes per loader. Full cache falls back to the original conversion path. Preserve all image pixels, camera geometry, training/evaluation splits, steps, resolution and Gaussian budget.
plan.acceptance: Test exact GPU pixel values and cache immutability, budget/fallback; validate actual consumed cache hits and same-camera held-out metrics on all three scenes. Final models are not guaranteed deterministic; do not equate changed Gaussian counts with algorithm speedup.

raw_runs.measurement: adapter training, evaluation and export; excludes SfM and input copy

timing_scope: Serial adapter training/evaluation/export, including per-process first image cache population. Excludes SfM and input copy; OS and driver caches not flushed. Same instrumented binary in both variants.
quality_scope: Frozen shared-camera geometry per scene, every eighth photo excluded from training but used in SfM; all scores recomputed at long edge 512. Two repeats do not establish general gains.
memory_scope: Logical f32 image tensor storage only; not allocator capacity or peak process/GPU memory.

projects.name: Faster-GS
projects.relevance: Separates implementation-level speedups from changes in quality or Gaussian count. This experiment adopts that evaluation distinction; no CUDA code is ported.

projects.name: FastGS
projects.relevance: Multi-view density control and optimized CUDA implementation; official README requires a CUDA GPU. Reported paper timings do not apply to this Metal host.

projects.name: EffGS
projects.relevance: Frequency-aware guidance, localized density control and scale modulation are possible later hypotheses; not implemented or benchmarked here.

validation.gpu_cache_test: passed: exact GPU pixels, cached tensor unaffected by caller operations, exact byte budget, oversized fallback and disabled cache

browser.observations: Fine pipes, cables and small text remain blurred; roaming outside capture coverage still shows stretched fragments and missing detail.

decision: Do not enable by default: caching removes repeated image conversion/upload but has no measurable training wall-time benefit here and retains up to 189 MiB of logical image data. Keep the experiment; next measure GPU rasterization/loss/optimizer costs before changing kernels.
